description.value: Newman's Fine Foods is a family-run specialty butcher and fine foods shop established in 1983 (originally as Seafair Gourmet Meats in West Richmond), now located in Delta and offering dry-aged and hormone-free meats sourced from named local BC farms. Beyond butchery, the shop functions as a gourmet deli with freshly made sandwiches, daily soups, take-away meals, artisanal cheeses, and charcuterie boards. It is a high-quality grab-and-go stop for cyclists passing through Delta's Springs neighbourhood.
